title: Caught by the Smugglers
trigger: The characters are spotted while scouting the cove
body:
## Flow

Disarmed and bound, the characters are brought before Fenn, the
leader of the smugglers. He questions each of them alone: Who sent you?
How much do you know?

## If: they admit to working for Jorna

Fenn has them locked in the old smokehouse — he wants to talk to
whoever hired him before he decides. The party has until
dawn to escape.

- break open the rotten boards of the back wall
- charm or bribe the bored guard
- clever use of a cantrip

> [!note] Safety valve: the captured lighthouse keeper in the
> next chamber knows of a loose floorboard.

## If: they lie (shipwrecked, lost travellers ...)

> [!check] Charisma (Deception) of each character vs. Fenn's
> Wisdom (Insight) +2. Advantage/Disadvantage by plausibility,
> for each character separately.

- **Believed** → they are escorted to the village and watched
- **Not believed** → smokehouse as above

> [!outcome] After this scene Fenn knows the party's faces —
> however it ends.
